integrity: Self-contained proof with a finite independent computational cross-check. Finite enumeration is not a proof for arbitrary parameters. Self-review only, with no independent audit or external certification.
scientific_limitations: Only finite monogenic semigroups and nonempty-subset power semigroups over finite abelian host groups are treated. Nothing is asserted for arbitrary multi-generator targets or for optimality among nonabelian groups. Older unavailable full texts create a residual originality risk.
title: Minimum abelian power-semigroup hosts for finite monogenic semigroups
